agent.name: aldric-ferryman
agent.seed_identity: Aldric, the ferryman at the river crossing — patient, watchful, keeps count of every crossing and every coin.
agent.diagnosticity_goal: what changes at the river crossing and who causes it

events.text: The spring flood washed out the ford below the mill; carts have been crossing on the old stone bridge since.
Master Brandt's forge went cold for three days when his bellows split; the new leather came in from the tanner on market day.
The baron's tax collector counted every barrel in the cellar and marked two of them with red chalk.
What happened to the ford by the mill in the spring flood?
How is Brandt's forge doing since the bellows split?

agent.name: hedda-innkeeper
agent.seed_identity: Hedda, who keeps the inn by the mill road and hears every debt settled or dodged at her long table.
agent.diagnosticity_goal: who owes what, and who made good on it

events.text: The miller Osric paid his grain debt in full on the feast of Saint Anselm, counted out in silver at the inn's long table.
A traveling dyer sold indigo cloth by the church steps and left before sundown.

events.content: The miller Osric paid only half his grain debt on the feast of Saint Anselm; the other half is promised by harvest.

events.text: Did Osric ever settle his grain debt, and how much is still owed?

title: Pin + decay: membership survives a 40-day age jump

agent.name: bertram-stablehand
agent.seed_identity: Bertram, the stablehand at the manor — slow to speak, misses nothing that happens in the yard.
agent.diagnosticity_goal: small changes in the yard and who caused them

events.text: The first hard frost split the rain barrel behind the stable, and the ice held a sparrow's print like a seal in wax.
Wenna the herbalist hung rosehips to dry along the rafters before the snow closed the high road.
Two of the baron's hounds got loose in the orchard and treed the miller's cat until dusk.
Tell me what you remember of this winter — the frost, the herbs, the hounds, all of it.

agent.name: maud-harbormaster
agent.seed_identity: Maud, the harbormaster's clerk — tallies every catch and quarrel on the quay.
agent.diagnosticity_goal: what moves through the harbor and who argues over it

events.text: At the harbor market, the fishwife Maren argued the price of eels with a one-eyed sailor until the bell rang noon.
Up at the hill pasture, the shepherd boy Col lost two lambs in the bracken and found them by their bleating at dusk.
What was all that shouting about eels at the market?
What do you know about the shepherd boy and his lambs?

agent.name: toll-warden
agent.seed_identity: The toll warden at the bridge gate, who counts carts the way other men count prayers.
agent.diagnosticity_goal: what blocks the bridge and for how long

events.text: The chandler's cart lost a wheel on the bridge and blocked the toll gate for an hour.
What happened on the bridge today?
